With private value $30 and independent draws, bid your value to maximize expected long-run profit. Ties resolved randomly, but no systematic benefit to deviating.]

[In a second-price sealed-bid auction with independent private values, bidding my true value is a weakly dominant strategy. Overbidding can create negative profit if I win and the second price exceeds my value; underbidding can forfeit positive-profit wins. Values are redrawn each round, but this is a single round. Therefore I will bid my private value exactly, using the discrete increment allowed.]

[This is a second-price (Vickrey) auction. Bidding your true private value ($24) is a dominant strategy: you win whenever the highest competing bid is below $24 and pay the second-highest bid, never overpaying. Bidding higher risks winning at a price above your value; bidding lower risks losing profitable wins. Therefore bid $24.]
